svg.title: QueryPilot architecture
svg.desc: QueryPilot architecture: React chat UI (SSE) to a FastAPI agent, a pgvector schema retriever, an LLM that plans and generates SQL, sqlglot guardrails (read-only, LIMIT, PII mask, EXPLAIN cost), MCP server tools (list_schemas, describe_table, run_readonly_query, explain_query) and a read-replica warehouse, with a self-correcting loop of up to 3 retries. Alongside: an eval harness of 300 golden questions gated in GitHub Actions, a Redis cache and OpenTelemetry traces.
